_comment: PUBLISHED ORDER of the MQTT API reference pages. This file answers exactly one question: in what sequence do the individual MQTT APIs appear? Nothing else.
_source_of_truth: sidebars/api-mqtt.ts is the source of this order. It is the only place the editorial sequence is decided, and it is fully explicit there (every entry is a type:'doc' id; nothing is autogenerated). This file is a flattened projection of it, kept in step by the order gate.
_deliberately_absent: SUBCATEGORIES AND SUB-SUBCATEGORIES ARE NOT REPRESENTED HERE, BY DESIGN. Groupings such as 'Device Status', 'Network Configuration' or 'Tag Filtering' exist for the sidebar rail alone. The AsyncAPI contract has no concept of them, so copying them into a generator input would invent a taxonomy the statement of truth does not carry, and would then need syncing in two places. The predecessor file (config/tag_config.json) did exactly that: it held tag_groups and operation_tags alongside an operation_order keyed BY subcategory. Only the order survives.
_naming: Renamed from tag_config.json on 2026-09-08. 'tag' is the most overloaded word in this repository -- everywhere else it means an RFID tag -- so a file about documentation grouping called tag_config was actively misleading. This name says what the file holds and what it is for.
